config.name: baseline_lgbm_medium
config.hypothesis: The official example-model recipe (LightGBM, medium features, every 4th era) reproduces a CORR in the same range as Numerai's reference validation predictions.

config.name: lgbm_all_stride4
config.hypothesis: Using all 3555 features instead of medium (780) raises dev CORR, holding model fixed. Previous: > The official example-model recipe (LightGBM, medium features, every 4th era) reproduces a CORR in the same range as Numerai's reference validation predictions.

config.name: lgbm_all_deep
config.hypothesis: Deeper trees (closer to Numerai's benchmark settings) improve dev CORR over the depth-5 model on all features, at the same data and learning-rate x rounds budget.

config.name: lgbm_all_bag4
config.hypothesis: Averaging four models trained on disjoint every-4th-era subsets (all training data, constant memory) beats a single every-4th-era model.

config.name: lgbm_all_resid_bench
config.hypothesis: Training on target_ender_60 residualized (per era) against the v53_lgbm_ender60 benchmark's out-of-sample train predictions yields positive BMC, i.e. signal the benchmark lacks. Only train eras with benchmark predictions (~157+) are usable.
